picks.b: A teacher wakes alone on a spaceship with no memory and has to save a dying sun.
A young Earthbender learns she is the new Avatar, and it makes her a target.
A man stakes everything on being first to the summit of Mount Everest.
Two Green Lanterns work a murder case in small-town America.
A hopeless romantic gets his wish and then pays for it, in a dark romance-horror.
Kayce Dutton leaves the ranch behind to join a Montana U.S. Marshals unit.
Two mob families go to war, and everyone around them is caught in it.
The toys face a new rival for Bonnie's attention: a tablet.
A detective chases a missing victim while his protégé goes undercover with a killer.
A whistleblower and a meteorologist team up to prove we are not alone.
Vision, hunted and fighting Ultron's pull, tries to stay himself.
A widow's in-laws turn into fear-eating creatures in this Evil Dead entry.
